kendalls_w_conclusion: W DECREASES from 0.6667 (5 axes) to 0.4444 (3 uncontaminated axes). At n=3 items this is a very thin test (Friedman's exact null distribution is coarse at this size -- p=0.2636, not significant at alpha=0.05 either way), so treat the point estimate as illustrative, not a precision claim.
sd_ordering_conclusion: The equal-weighting < calibrated SD ordering HOLDS when restricted to only the 3 uncontaminated axes' 18 mapped reactions (equal=0.1317 vs. calibrated=0.2594), matching the direction found across all 5 axes' reactions (equal=0.1225 vs. calibrated=0.2883) and across the full 12931-reaction population (item 9: equal=0.1236 vs. calibrated=0.2002). This specific ordering does not appear to depend on the two growth-support-contaminated axes.
